text_block_list.text:
With the new year, Orfevre has entered
the Classic Year. Finally, this year...
As originally planned, she will challenge the Classic Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: (Before that... we have to start with that first.)
(Before that... we have to start with that first.)

text_block_list.text: Her solo training went smoothly, and on the final day of the year's schedule, as I walked Orfevre back to the dormitory...
choice_data_list: Next time we meet, it'll be the new year
Next time we meet, it'll be the new year, huh

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way,
is the invitation still not here?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A New Year's banquet. You shall host it, of course.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
At last, the crown shall return to me...
I trust the ceremony will be held with utmost grandeur.

And so, giving up the New Year's holidays,
preparations were underway for a New Year's party
dedicated to Orfevre.

Though it started because someone told me to...
thinking that it would help boost Orfevre's
motivation got me fully fired up as well.

And on the day of the party,
after decorating the Trainer's office and making all the preparations,
I welcomed Orfevre inside.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Handle things as you see fit this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So.
Is this the banquet you have prepared?
choice_data_list: Yeah, the food is over there!
Yeah, the food is over there!

text_block_list.text:
I checked her likes and dislikes in the subjects' group LINE chat,
learned how to make flashy and extravagant New Year's dishes,
and prepared the meal.
choice_data_list: Let's make the decorations as flashy as possible!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Red, gold... It certainly catches the eye.
choice_data_list: It's the King's color—auspicious, isn't it?
It's the King's color—auspicious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
not bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "So, what tribute do you offer?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A spectacle is essential
for a King's banquet.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
With you around,
I am bound to see rare and curious things.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Live up to my expectations
to your heart's content.

Of course, I don't have any kind of show prepared.
I'll just have to improvise
something right here, right now...!

There are times when Orfevre tells me to prove my worth.
If I can show her what I'm capable of,
she might find it entertaining.
choice_data_list: Let me show you my power.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
let the King have a look.

I look around for anything useful.
That's when an item prepared just for hype
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...
Well then, show me what you can do."

I have experience playing kendama as a child.
One must utilize the entire body, making it an advanced sport
that demands delicate control over one's power.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... hahaha.

Orfevre is a King. Which means...
perhaps a regal ritual of sorts
would please her...?
choice_data_list: To the King... I shall offer something!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so, what will you offer?
choice_data_list: (I'll have to improvise something that looks the part—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
I've made up my mind."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You are the sacrifice.

In that instant, Orfevre abruptly closes the distance.
Is the shudder I feel being stared at from this close—
because those eyes are simply too beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... hahaha.

A spectacle... When you think of that, what immediately comes to mind
is something to watch... like a play or a dance.
If it has to be something we can do right this second...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: In other words, you are confident you can satisfy my aesthetic eye.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Flutter, dance.
For my sake."

I was the one who brought it up. There's no backing down now.
Remembering the choreography from the Make Debut I watched in her lesson...
I dance with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Good, very good.
That was quite a bizarre spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Take it.

What Orfevre tossed over was... a small pouch.
It was packed with leaf-like contents and gave off a wonderful fragrance...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I had my sister make this.
It's a sachet.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
They say it has calming properties.
Just leave it by your pillow.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Take tomorrow off. Make up for it with hard work afterward."

It seems Orfevre is being considerate in her own way.
I can feel a slight increase in our mutual trust.

Since it's the New Year season, I came to watch the sunrise
to soak in the festive atmosphere. Perhaps because it wasn't
the *first* sunrise of the year, there wasn't a soul around—

—Huh, it's quite pretty.
...Was this the thing that called out to me?

She picks something up from the beach... and is talking to it. Her eyes shimmer with a mysterious brilliance—
and suddenly, our eyes meet.

Hm? You're......—
...Ah, I see.

Well well, Happy New Year.
—And this... belongs to you.

What she handed me was...
a small, beautiful gold pendant.
Its delicate craftsmanship and radiant shine took my breath away...

When I looked up,
the Umamusume was... already gone.
